name: wishing-star
text: A stone found in the Galar region with a mysterious power. It’s said that your dreams come true if you find one.

name: dynamax-band
text: A Wishing Star has been affixed to it. It lets out a light that allows Pokémon to Dynamax when at a Power Spot.

name: fishing-rod--galar
text: Use it by the water to fish up various kinds of Pokémon.

name: rotom-bike
text: This bike can be combined with the Pokémon Rotom to use a turbo boost.

name: sausages
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. These sausages should be boiled before eating.

name: bobs-food-tin
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The tinned food that Bob sells is curiously popular in Galar.

name: bachs-food-tin
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The tinned food that Bach sells is curiously popular in Galar.

name: tin-of-beans
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. When simmered, the beans suffuse a dish with their mild flavor.

name: bread
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. An indispensable tool for mopping up that extra curry left on your plate.

name: pasta
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. These flour noodles make for a surprisingly good match with curry.

name: mixed-mushrooms
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The chewy texture of the mushrooms transforms any dish they’re added to.

name: smoke-poke-tail
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. When a Slowpoke’s tail falls off, it grows back quickly.

name: large-leek
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Whether this is the kind of vegetable stalk that Farfetch’d like is unknown.

name: fancy-apple
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. An apple chosen above others. It has spectacular form and a brilliant sheen.

name: brittle-bones
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The taste boiled off from the bones is sure to give a dish a light umami taste.

name: pack-of-potatoes
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Potatoes help mellow out a spicy taste, to make a dish more mild.

name: pungent-root
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Though carelessly picked, these herbs can add a fragrant accent to a dish.

name: salad-mix
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The assortment of vegetables looks quite appealing and healthy.

name: fried-food
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. It’s been a while since it was fried, so it’s gotten greasy.

name: boiled-egg
text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Even just one boiled egg can really enhance a dish.

name: camping-gear
text: Everything you need to set up a tent and get cooking in a Wild Area or at a camping spot.

name: rusted-sword
text: It is said that a hero used this sword to halt a terrible disaster in ancient times. But it’s grown rusty and worn.

name: rusted-shield
text: It is said that a hero used this shield to halt a terrible disaster in ancient times. But it’s grown rusty and worn.

name: fossilized-bird
text: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once soared through the sky. What it looked like is a mystery.

name: fossilized-fish
text: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once lived in the sea. What it looked like is a mystery.

name: fossilized-drake
text: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once roamed the land. What it looked like is a mystery.

name: fossilized-dino
text: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once lived in the sea. What it looked like is a mystery.

name: strawberry-sweet
text: A strawberry-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it will spin around happily.

name: love-sweet

name: berry-sweet
text: A berry-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

name: clover-sweet

name: ribbon-sweet

name: sweet-apple
text: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It’s exceptionally sweet.

name: tart-apple
text: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It’s exceptionally tart.

name: throat-spray
text: Raises Sp. Atk when a Pokémon uses a sound-based move.

name: eject-pack
text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder’s stats are lowered, it will be switched out of battle.

name: heavy-duty-boots
text: These boots prevent the effects of traps set on the battlefield.

name: blunder-policy
text: Raises Speed sharply when a Pokémon misses with a move because of accuracy.

name: room-service
text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Lowers Speed when Trick Room takes effect.

name: utility-umbrella
text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This sturdy umbrella protects the holder from the effects of rain and harsh sunlight.

name: exp-candy-xs
text: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a very small amount of Exp. Points.

name: exp-candy-s
text: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a small amount of Exp. Points.

name: exp-candy-m
text: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a moderate amount of Exp. Points.

name: exp-candy-l
text: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a large amount of Exp. Points.

name: exp-candy-xl
text: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a very large amount of Exp. Points.

name: dynamax-candy
text: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will raise the Dynamax Level of a single Pokémon by one. A higher level means higher HP when Dynamaxed.

name: tr00
text: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

name: tr01
text: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

text: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

text: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

name: tr12
text: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

name: tr13
text: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

name: tr14
text: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

name: tr15
text: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

name: tr16
text: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

name: tr17

name: tr18
text: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

name: tr19
text: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

name: tr20
text: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

name: tr21
text: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

name: tr22
text: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

text: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.

name: tr24
text: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

name: tr25
text: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

name: tr26
text: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

name: tr27
text: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

name: tr28
text: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

name: tr29
text: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

name: tr30
text: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

name: tr31
text: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

name: tr32
text: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

name: tr33
text: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

name: tr34
text: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

name: tr35
text: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

name: tr36
text: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave those Pokémon with a burn.

name: tr37
text: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

name: tr38
text: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

name: tr39
text: The user attacks the target with great power. However, this also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.

text: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

name: tr44
text: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

text: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

name: tr46
text: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

name: tr47
text: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.

name: tr49

name: tr50
text: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by cutting its target. Critical hits land more easily.

name: tr51
text: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that raises its Attack and Speed stats.

name: tr52

name: tr53
text: The user fights the target up close without guarding itself. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

name: tr54
text: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

name: tr60

text: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

name: tr62

name: tr63

name: tr64
text: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

name: tr65
text: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

name: tr66
text: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

name: tr67
text: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

name: tr68
text: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

name: tr69
text: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

text: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

text: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.

name: tr75

text: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

name: tr77
text: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

name: tr78
text: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those hit.

name: tr79
text: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power.

name: tr80
text: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move’s power.

name: tr81
text: The user turns the target’s power against it. The higher the target’s Attack stat, the greater the damage it deals.

name: tr82

name: tr83
text: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies.

name: tr84
text: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

name: tr85

text: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

name: tr87

name: tr88
text: The user slams its target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power.

name: tr89

name: tr90

text: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

name: tr94
text: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

name: tr97

name: max-honey
text: Honey that Dynamax Vespiquen produces. Adding this honey to Max Soup makes the taste very smooth. It also has the same effect as a Max Revive.

name: max-mushrooms
text: Mushrooms that have the power of changing Dynamax forms. They boost all stats of a Pokémon during battle.

name: galarica-twig
text: A twig from a species of tree called Galarica that grows in certain areas around the Galar region. It’s a material for an accessory for a certain Pokémon.

name: galarica-cuff
text: A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Giving it to Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.

name: style-card
text: A card that increases the selection in boutiques and hair salons.

name: armor-pass
text: A pass to go to the Isle of Armor. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.

name: rotom-bike--sparkling-white
text: This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water using Rotom’s power. It’s a sparkling white that shines brilliantly.

name: rotom-bike--glistening-black
text: This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water using Rotom’s power. It’s a glistening black that shines reddish-black.

name: exp-charm
text: A charm that increases the Exp. Points that Pokémon can get. A machine-like object is inside the charm.

name: armorite-ore
text: Rare ore that can be obtained on the Isle of Armor. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector on the Isle of Armor.

name: mark-charm
text: A mysterious and unique charm that increases the chance of finding a Pokémon with a mark.

name: reins-of-unity--merge
text: Reins that people presented to the king. They enhance Calyrex’s power over bountiful harvests and unite Calyrex with its beloved steed.

name: reins-of-unity--split
text: Reins that people presented to the king. They enable those who are connected to communicate with each other. The reins separate Calyrex and its beloved steed.

name: galarica-wreath
text: A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Placing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.

name: legendary-clue-1
text: A clue about the King of Bountiful Harvests. It’s written by Peony, and an old photo is attached to it.

name: legendary-clue-2
text: A clue about the legend of giants. It’s written by Peony and has unique drawings.

name: legendary-clue-3
text: A clue about the legend of bird Pokémon. It’s written by Peony and has a unique drawing.

name: legendary-clue-question
text: A mysterious clue that Peony seems to have dropped. There’s a photo attached to it showing a shining hole opening above the Max Lair.

name: crown-pass
text: A pass to go to the Crown Tundra. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.

name: wooden-crown
text: A mysterious object made of wood. Part of it seems to be chipped. Maybe it’s meant to be part of something.

name: radiant-petal
text: A single petal that the King of Bountiful Harvests gave you. It radiates faint light.

name: white-mane-hair
text: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed, Glastrier. The hair is strong and very flexible.

name: black-mane-hair
text: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed, Spectrier. The hair is very smooth to the touch.

name: iceroot-carrot
text: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a field covered in snow.

name: shaderoot-carrot
text: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a gloomy field.

name: dynite-ore
text: Mysterious ore that can be obtained in the Max Lair. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector in the Crown Tundra.

name: carrot-seeds
text: Seeds to plant in a field. The kind of carrot you’ll get is determined by which field you plant the seeds in.

name: ability-patch
text: A patch that allows a Pokémon with a regular Ability to have a rare Ability.

name: reins-of-unity
text: Cords that shine when you hold them up to the light. The people of old times presented these to the King of Bountiful Harvests to express their gratitude.

name: linking-cord
effect: Allows a Pokemon whose evolution is usually triggered by trading to evolve

name: laheavy-ball
text: Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokémon hasn't noticed the player.

name: laleaden-ball
text: Upgraded version of the Heavy Ball. Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokémon hasn't noticed the player.

name: lagigaton-ball
text: Upgraded version of the Leaden Ball. Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokémon hasn't noticed the player.

name: lafeather-ball
text: Can be thrown further than a regular Poké Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.

name: lawing-ball
text: Can be thrown further than a Feather Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.

name: lajet-ball
text: Can be thrown further than a Wing Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.
